question.text: An LCR series circuit of capacitance <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>62</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn><mo> </mo><mi>nF</mi></math> and resistance of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Ω</mi></math>, is connected to an A.C. source of frequency <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi>kHz</mi></math>. For maximum value of amplitude of current in circuit, the value of inductance is ____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>mH</mi></math>.<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced open=""><mrow><mo>(</mo><mtext>Take</mtext><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">π</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>

solution.text:
Given here, f=2 kHz=2000 Hz, C=62.5 nF=62.5×10-9 F and R=50 Ω

Resonance frequency (amplitude of the current will be maximum in this case) is given by f=12πLC, here, L is the inductance.

Putting the values, 

2000 Hz=12πL×62.5×10-9

L=14π2×20002×62.5×10-9=0.1 H=100 mH
